name: dispatch
description: Activate when you identify 2+ independent work units that could execute in parallel. Triggers include phrases like "do these in parallel", "split this into subagents", "dispatch these tasks", or self-recognition that a workload decomposes into units with no shared mutable state. Also activates when you are about to spawn multiple subagents for concurrent execution.

conditions: Agent identifies 2+ independent work units with no shared mutable state
Agent is about to spawn multiple subagents for concurrent execution

hook_points.verification: Independence matrix complete: all pairs resolved
Reconciliation plan exists for every work unit
All acceptance criteria met; merged deliverable passes checks
